For example, the Son Tung logging company used to cut trees a lot, which led to the biggest flood ever recorded in the history of Vietnam.

Fortunately, several measures can be done to deal with this issue. Firstly, entrepreneurs can apply technological developments to recycle trash, so that, these trash can be used again and again. By following this idea, enterprises can reduce the regularity of leaving trash in the nature. Secondly, the government should apply some laws against exploiting natural resources. For example, if I keep illegally deforesting the Amazon rainforest despite not being allowed to do it, I might result in  permanently being in jail as a punishment or even being put to death penalty.


In conclusion, when manufacturing consumer goods, people exploit resources from and throw trash at the environment, which would lead to negative impacts on nature. Applying the newest technologies and some strict laws can help to solve this serious issue.

essay.text:
Education plays a pivotal role in children’s developmental years, and the quality of which requires the dedication of both students and teachers. Unfortunately, it is found that children in schools are not engrossed in study. Does this mean that teachers are unqualified or are students themselves to blame? What are the remedies to overcome this problem?
Adolescents’ innate characteristics should be brought into close scrutiny. Children, as non-grownups, are generally less self-disciplined. This means that they are ofttimes unable to control their concentration, easily affected by distractions such as a sudden sound or an idea that pops up and is unrelated with the class.  Each time students get sidetracked, they would miss the important points that teachers are elaborating. To combat this productivity-damaging weakness, there should be more research on strengthening children’s concentration. The ability to focus on important tasks for a longer duration of time could keep students from absent-mindedness and boost learning efficiency.
Another cause of this problem is attributed to ineffective teaching. These days, many teachers are not doing a good job. They constantly adopt teacher-centred methods in class, without taking into account students’ preferences.  This inappropriate method could demotivate students, making them lose interest in study. The solution would be to opt for a student-centred attitude. Teachers could integrate into their class livelier and more inspiring elements, so that the classes they teach would be more in line with young people’s taste.  With an intense interest in what the teachers are saying, the students would voluntarily engross themselves in these absorbing topics.
In summary, adolescents’ shortcoming in self-discipline and the mechanical teaching strategy chosen by teachers are held accountable for pupils’ inability to focus on study. The suggested recipes are to enhance those young people’s concentration and to put a higher value on what they are fond of.

Some believe technology has made our lives too complex and the solution is to lead a simpler life without technology.

Nowadays, many are of the opinion that technology has complicated our lives and that living without it would make life so much simpler. Although I agree that technology has drawbacks, turning our backs on it would be a huge setback for mankind.

To begin with, technology has played a crucial role in changing human communication, lifestyle and work for the better. Firstly, thanks to the invention of the Internet, people can now be updated with current affairs faster than ever. In addition, social apps such as Facebook and Twitter have allowed them to be in touch with their close ones more often with just a press of a button. Secondly, advances in broadcasting have provided numerous forms of entertainment. This greatly benefits individuals as well as improves their quality of life. Finally, the rise of automation has significantly reduced labour work and increased productivity. For example, manual tasks such as calculating or sorting, and memorizing can now be done by cutting-edge computers with high precision and reliability in a relatively short time. 

Even though technology has made our lives become more complicated and it is a negative trend, there are several measures to help to alleviate the problem. One of the most effective ways is to change individuals’ attitudes toward technology. Indeed, instead of considering it as an indispensable part of our life, people should treat technology as a tool with the sole purpose being to ease their lives. By doing so, they will not become too dependent on it and free their minds. Another possible way is returning to low-tech devices. To be specific, studies have shown that people may be happier and more satisfied if they are given fewer options in life. Hence, by using devices with few quirks and features, it is likely that they may experience a more fulfilling life, as well as appreciate what they have. For example, instead of using smartphones, millions of teenagers in Europe are now buying dial phones, also known as dumb-phones, because these help them to stay away from the dramas on social media, control their lives better, and see the world with more grace

In conclusion, while I agree that technology is making our lives more complex, humans will not likely lead a simpler life if we reject it. Instead, we should change our mindsets toward it and try to use low-tech devices rather than chasing after the latest technologies to live healthier and simpler.

prompt.text: Some people think that it is better for older schoolchildren to study a large number of subjects and develop a wide range of knowledge. Others argue that they should study a smaller number of subjects and focus on details. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

essay.text:
Over the past decade, by virtue of advanced living standards, the educational system has gained popularity in various countries, leading to a paradigm shift in the application of multiple subjects at schools. This, therefore, is believed to be beneficial for learners. Despite the many positive ramifications that may derive from the argument, this educating style is likely to be predominantly disadvantageous to students due to the rationales outlined below. 

Admittedly, advocates of the statement that adolescent students should better learn a variety of subjects at schools may argue that this implementation not only offers learners many useful skills but also enables a foreseeable well-rounded individual. First, when attending to some intellectual subjects, namely chemistry or math, students are able to enhance their cognitive abilities. Some examples of this, particularly include the improvement of problem-solving skills like balancing chemical equations or addressing chemical reactions. Second, since a multi-subjects educating style is implemented, this necessitates a well-developed citizen. By studying many majors at schools, students might get a deeper insight into every aspect of life, leading to a complete understanding of their future.

Nevertheless, despite the feasible positive impacts above, focusing on some chosen subjects is still the optimal choice. First, favorite majors act as incentives for youngsters’ passion and motivation in learning. It should be remembered that once adolescents are encouraged to engage in the fields they are interested in, they will have opportunities to foster their talents and potential abilities themselves, therefore minimizing teachers’ efforts in terms of helping learners understand the lessons. In addition, once students can select their favored subjects, a self-learning style will be granted. If young learners can make a decision on what they will study, their independence and autonomy skills in learning will be ensured, leading to a responsible individual later on. 

In conclusion, despite the ubiquity of multi-subject avenues in education, prioritizing several selected subjects remains the most preferred choice due to the autonomic and favorable features. Because of these merits, I do expect government development aims to be drastically altered in the foreseeable future.

    - "advance living standards" -> "improved living conditions"
    - "educational system has gained popularity" -> "education has become more prevalent"
    - "leading to a paradigm shift in the application of multiple subjects at schools" -> "resulting in a change in the approach to teaching multiple subjects in schools"
    - "this is likely to be predominantly disadvantageous to students" -> "this approach may have several drawbacks for students"
- **Corrections:**
    - "adolescent students should better learn a variety of subjects at schools" -> "younger students should study a broad range of subjects in school"
    - "this implementation not only offers learners many useful skills but also enables a foreseeable well-rounded individual" -> "this approach not only provides learners with a diverse skill set but also fosters their overall development"
    - "favorite majors act as incentives for youngsters’ passion and motivation in learning" -> "students are more likely to be engaged and motivated when they focus on subjects that align with their interests"

- **Mistakes:**
    - "may derive from the argument" -> "may result from this approach"
    - "advocates of the statement that adolescent students should better learn a variety of subjects at schools" -> "proponents of the view that secondary students should study a broad range of subjects"
    - "First, when attending to some intellectual subjects, namely chemistry or math, students are able to enhance their cognitive abilities" -> "Firstly, studying subjects like chemistry and mathematics can enhance students' cognitive abilities"
- **Corrections:**
    - "Second, since a multi-subjects educating style is implemented, this necessitates a well-developed citizen" -> "Secondly, by implementing a multidisciplinary approach to education, we can foster well-rounded individuals"
    - "favorite majors act as incentives for youngsters’ passion and motivation in learning" -> "students are more likely to be passionate and motivated when they focus on subjects that align with their interests"

It has been a topic of debate about how best to teach children teamwork, and the debate remains open to this day. Many people believe that team sports is the best way to achieve this goal. But, in my opinion, there are better solutions than this method.

Firstly, team sports at school can teach children important values such as teamwork and communication. By being in the communication circle with other pupils, they develop their social skills. Because not only one player or member of the team can win a game or competition. They should work together and understand each other for achieving the goal. Additionally, playing team sports brings students more happiness than individual sports and helps them make new friends, which can motivate them to collaborate with others in the future.

On the other hand, other methods such as working in groups to solve a practical problem are also effective in increasing students' cooperative spirit. For example, many schools have multiple interdisciplinary programs that require team members who are proficient in different subjects. Without joint efforts, children will never be able to reach a satisfactory solution. As a result, they will understand how important it is to collaborate and learn from each other. Meanwhile, students working in these collaborative projects will also find collaboration beneficial as it can improve their problem-solving skills and improve their knowledge of all subjects involved.

In conclusion, although playing team sports is good for helping children learn the importance of cooperation, I think teachers can come up with better ways to encourage their students to work together.

prompt.text: Some people think that illegal Internet downloads are having a negative effect on the music industry. Others feel that they have little or no impact on artists. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

essay.text:
The music industry has changed vastly since the golden days of Beethoven and Mozart. With the rapid growth of the internet and smartphones, listening to music has become easier than ever. Instead of having to attend concerts, listeners can just plug their headphones into a smartphone and listen to music online. While this has its fair share of benefits, record labels have been hesitant to expand into the online music industry since it has various drawbacks, including piracy issues and monetization. In this essay, I will discuss the aforementioned issues as well as giving my own opinion.

On one hand, the explosive growth of online music websites has made it exponentially harder for record labels and artists to control and monetize their work. These people are concerned that as the internet music industry grows, so do the piracy issues. This may cause everyone to copy each other, making music seem unoriginal and uninterested. It can also discourage artists to produce and release music, as there are no ways for them to ensure that their music is being used as they intended as well as controlling where their works are being published. Overall, illegal Internet downloads can have negative effects on the artists and the music industry as a whole.

On the other hand, having the ability to publish music on the internet - where millions of users are actively using and discussing every day - has helped new artists get discovered and grow. Moreover, the growth of music piracy has pushed streaming platforms to take extra steps to prevent illegal downloads. It's not hard to understand why in the early 2000s, record labels and artists were trying to take down music streaming platforms that were allowing users to download music freely and distribute it wherever they please. The most notable case of this is perhaps Napster, as this platform was taken down after a huge wave of protests to protect the rights of composers. Because of this, most streaming platforms like Spotify and Apple Music include features that help artists control their music distribution and monetization. Therefore, it's almost impossible to pirate music now, unlike in the 2000s. 

To summarize, illegal Internet downloads can and have caused a ton of issues regarding piracy and monetization, but they helped push the development of tools to ensure these issues never happen again. Therefore, it's safe to say that illegal downloads aren't an issue in the modern world.

While interviews can give an initial impression of a candidate, they may not provide a complete picture of their skills, personality, and work style. Interviews may also be subject to biases, such as unconscious biases or interviewer biases, which can affect the outcome of the selection process.

Additionally, some candidates may perform well in an interview but not be a good fit for the job, while others may not perform as well in an interview but have the necessary skills and qualities for the job.

Therefore, while interviews can be a useful selection method, they should not be relied on solely to make hiring decisions. Combining interviews with other selection methods may provide a more comprehensive assessment of candidates and increase the chances of making a successful hire.

The increase in production of consumer goods can cause damage to the natural environment due to several reasons. One of the main causes is the overuse of natural resources such as water, timber, and minerals. The extraction of these resources can lead to deforestation, soil erosion, and pollution of water bodies.

Another cause is the use of harmful chemicals and materials in the production process. These chemicals can be released into the environment during production, use, or disposal, leading to air and water pollution, soil contamination, and harm to wildlife.

To solve this problem, there are several steps that can be taken. One approach is to promote sustainable production and consumption practices. This can be done by reducing waste, improving resource efficiency, and using renewable energy sources.

Another solution is to implement regulations and policies that limit the use of harmful chemicals and materials in production processes. This can be achieved through the enforcement of environmental laws and regulations, as well as through the development of eco-friendly technologies.

Finally, raising public awareness about the impact of consumer goods on the environment can encourage individuals to make more sustainable choices in their daily lives.

On the one hand, working or travelling for a period of time instead of going to university directly can make those people more familiar with the working and living environment after graduation, and know the difficulties and hardships of making money, which can make them more enthusiastic about studying after entering university. And students can also take a gap year to engage in some high-tech jobs so that they can know where their knowledge is lacking, so they can focus on learning the knowledge they are not good at after entering university.

On the other hand, students do not go to college directly but go to work or travel for a period of time, which will increase their time away from campus. This will cause them a lot of trouble as they cannot adapt to campus life after they enter the university campus. They cannot focus on their studies and life, which may prevent them from passing exams or graduating. And bad habits developed during previous gap years may make their studies difficult during college.

In general, taking a gap year instead of going directly to college is also an option for students. Students need to weigh the pros and cons and make a decision that they will not regret.
